title: The Temple Theme Kit's 14 photographs and 10 house glyphs are in the repo, byte for byte as designed
detail: Pass 1a of the Temple Theme Kit (code id temple-kit; Royal Temple's temple theme is untouched): assets/images/photo-01..14.jpg to public/sites/temple-kit/photos and assets/glyphs/*.svg to public/sites/temple-kit/glyphs. Closes 24 asset gaps from the design-system baseline. The 24 textures follow with the theme data in the next pass.
